title: Half of PRIDE’s 3.3-fold growth came from Europe, yet China (5.2×) added more datasets than Germany (2.8×)
sub:
Circle area: datasets released 2023–2025, by the contributing group’s country; colour: multiple of the 2016–2018 count (archive-wide 3.3×). 3,632 and 12,085 country-resolved datasets
(78% of each period; the rest have no resolved country). Datasets added: Europe 4,218 (50%), North America 1,852 (22%), Asia 1,848 (22%; China 1,283). Deposits only: not ownership or national output.
